headline: Food service staff presents options on staying in the CEP free-meal program, estimating a $248,000 loss.
summary: The district has been in CEP for about five years, and the presentation said the state reimburses 78% of meals at the free rate. The presentation said returning to applications would need a lunch price rise of about a dollar and a breakfast rise of about 50 cents. Separately, RLE Phase II energy upgrades were recommended, at a $1,121,051 net cost after incentives. The 2027 meeting calendar was also approved.
decisions: Recommended RLE Phase II energy upgrades, net cost $1,121,051 after incentives, to advance to the full board.
Approved the 2027 Finance and Operations Committee meeting calendar.
discussion: CEP free-meal program: The presentation estimated about $248,000 in lost reimbursement, since some districts are reimbursed at 100%. Staying in CEP gives a predictable number, while returning to applications would need higher prices and a rehired employee.
Breakfast participation: Breakfast counts rose about 10% district-wide after bus times changed. A breakfast cart upstairs at Central is being considered to bring that number back up.

RLE Phase II energy upgrades: The project was described as 0% interest through Eversource and cash positive, with about $768 a month in savings after payment. The DDC work's incentive requires completion within 12 months.
Food science lab design: Design bids are due tomorrow, and interviews are set for December 16. The recommended team would go to the January committee meeting, then the February City Council meeting.
GoFan ticketing for athletics: GoFan would replace cash at games, with no fee and QR codes at the gates. Cash is still used next week, and equipment is due before December 5th.

decision_evidence.quote: Okay, may I have a motion to approve RLE Phase II recommendations to the full board for approval? ... All in favor, please say aye. ... Also carries.
may I have a motion to approve the 2027 Finance and Operations Committee meeting calendar? So move. ... Opposed? Motion carries.
